get.description: Everything the "new session" form can pick from (active items only).

patch.description: Changes one occurrence; the rest of its series is not affected.

post.description:
Stops a weekly series after a date: no more occurrences are generated, and later
sessions without bookings are cancelled. Sessions with bookings stay, to be handled
one by one (the business must tell those clients).

patch.description:
Changes time, length, capacity, place, instructor and notes of this and all later
sessions of a series; new occurrences the daily job adds follow the new settings.
Bookings stay; booked clients are told when the time changes.

post.description:
Copies the one-off sessions of a week (7 days from from_date) to another week, at the
same local weekday and time. Weekly series are left out: they repeat on their own.

get.description: Closed days from `start` (default: today, local) on.

post.description: Marks a day closed and cancels its scheduled sessions; booked clients are told.

delete.description: Opens the day again for new sessions; sessions cancelled when it closed stay cancelled.

get.description: The session's roster: live bookings first, then the waitlist in order, then history.

post.description: Books the client if a spot is free, otherwise adds them to the waitlist.

get.description: A client's bookings, newest session first.

put.description: Replaces the staff member's weekly working hours (blocks may not overlap).

get.description: The staff member's time off that hasn't ended yet, soonest first.

post.description:
Blocks whole days; appointments already booked in them stay (the business handles
them), but no new ones are offered.
Books a client into a free time with a staff member (staff may book without a plan).
The signed-in client books a free time (the business's booking rules apply).

get.description: What the client can book as a personal appointment.

patch.description: Changes apply to future sales only; sold entitlements keep their own terms.

post.description: Sells a plan to a client. Payment is simulated until a payment provider is connected.
Pauses the entitlement for the given days and extends its end date by as many days.
Stops the entitlement from being used for new bookings (no refund is simulated).

delete.description: Deletes a code nobody used; a used code is paused instead (its history stays).

get.description: Each metric for the period and for the period of the same length just before it.
Attendance metrics of sessions that took place, per service, instructor or time slot.

Members with a valid plan who haven't come in `days`, or whose plan ends within `days`
with no renewal.
Ratings in the last `days` days (or all of one client's).
Recent attended visits the client hasn't rated yet, newest first.

put.description: Replaces the business's modules (billing is simulated in the prototype).

post.description:
Adds one module to the plan (the "add to plan" button on a locked module). Choosing an AI
tier replaces the other one; adding a module the plan already has changes nothing.
Adds a test card (no card number is ever entered in the prototype).
Charges an open invoice to the business's (test) card.
Sends the welcome email once; later calls return it without sending again.

get.description: The first-steps checklist on the dashboard, from what the business has set up.
The price list for the marketing site (no sign-in).
Usage per day and meter, for one business or the whole platform.

The inbox: requests from the marketing site and complaints from businesses. Open ones
first, then newest.

patch.description: Moves a request along: status, who on the MyBiz side handles it, internal notes.

get.description: What MyBiz billed businesses, per month and currency (simulated charges).
The signed-in team member's level and permissions (the console shows what they hold).

put.description:
Adds a team member or changes one. Nobody changes the primary owner or themselves;
only owners handle owners and managers; nobody gives more than they hold.

get.description: What the MyBiz team did, newest first (owners only).

post.description: Lets platform support see the business (read-only) for the given hours.

A question or complaint from the business to the MyBiz team; it lands in the console's
inbox with the business attached.

get.description: Every business the signed-in user has joined as a client.

patch.description: The client's own name and phone in this business (nothing else).

get.description: Upcoming sessions in the window (past ones are left out).
Days the business is closed in the window (no classes; usually a holiday).

post.description: Books the signed-in client, or puts them on the waitlist when the session is full.

get.description: Newest first; for one client when `client_id` is given.

Receipts issued between two local dates (inclusive, in the business's time zone), with
totals: the sales page and its export for the accountant.

post.description: Approves or rejects a declaration that answered "yes" to a question.
Signs a new declaration; it replaces the previous one.
